# Realtime BPM Analyzer

> Free browser tools for tempo (BPM) work, plus the open-source TypeScript library that powers them. Audio is analysed locally in the browser. The website itself measures its pages with Google Analytics.

## Tools

- [BPM Finder](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/): finds the BPM of a song from an audio file, the microphone or a live radio stream, in the browser
- [Tap Tempo](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/tap-tempo): measures a tempo from taps (least-squares fit over the last 16 taps)
- [BPM to ms Calculator](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/bpm-to-ms): note lengths in ms and Hz, straight, dotted and triplet; quarter note ms = 60000 / BPM
- [Video BPM Finder](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/video-bpm): detects the BPM of the sound track of a video file (MP4, WebM, MOV when the browser decodes it), in the browser
- [BPM to Frames Calculator](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/bpm-to-frames): frames per beat and per bar at 23.976 to 60 fps or a custom rate; frames per beat = fps * 60 / BPM
- [Online Metronome](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/metronome): 20-300 BPM, 1-12 beats per bar, subdivisions, tap to set

## Privacy

- [Library Privacy](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/privacy): the library collects nothing and makes no network call of its own
- [Website Privacy](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/website-privacy): realtime-bpm-analyzer.com measures its own pages with Google Analytics through Google Tag Manager, while audio stays in the browser
- [Extension Privacy](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/extension/privacy): audio never leaves the device, the extension sends nothing of its own today, and the pages it opens are part of the website

## Library

- [Getting started](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/guide/getting-started): install `realtime-bpm-analyzer` from npm; zero dependencies, AudioWorklet-based
- [How it works](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/guide/how-it-works): peak detection, threshold scan and interval grouping
- [Realtime BPM detection](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/guide/realtime-bpm-detection): the tempo of an audio or video element, the microphone or a live stream, with an AudioWorklet
- [BPM from the microphone](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/guide/bpm-from-microphone): getUserMedia with voice processing off, permissions, HTTPS, iOS and cleanup
- [React BPM hook](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/guide/react-bpm-hook): useBpm, a typed hook for file, microphone and stream detection
- [Beat detection with Web Audio](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/guide/beat-detection-web-audio): onsets, tempo and beat tracking compared; the tempo of live audio and of whole files
- [Node.js](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/guide/node): BPM detection outside the browser
- [Strict CSP and browser extensions](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/guide/strict-csp): loading the worklet from a URL
- [API reference](https://www.realtime-bpm-analyzer.com/api/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/dlepaux/realtime-bpm-analyzer): Apache-2.0
